description: Ministry of Ports and Shipping - Merchant Shipping (Construction-Structure, Subdivision and Stability, Machinery and Electrical Installations) Regulations No. 02 of 2021
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Ports and Shipping under the Merchant Shipping Act, No. 52 of 1971. It establishes legal/regulatory frameworks for ship construction, structure, subdivision, stability, machinery, and electrical installations, giving effect to the International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes or organizational restructuring.
